newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ATHLETICS-INJURED BAILY PULLS OUT OF LINZ MEETING.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-INJURED BAILY PULLS OUT OF LINZ MEETING.

text.p: Canadian Olympic and world champion Donovan Bailey has pulled out of Wednesday's International althletics meeting in Linz because of a thigh injury, organisers said on Tuesday.
The 29-year-old world 100 metres record holder, who sustained the injury in Lausanne last Wednesday, was due to run in the 4x100m in the Canadian team which won gold at the 1996 Atlanta Olympics.
Bailey's manager Paul Donovan said in a statement sent to the Linz organisers that Bailey wanted to recover fully from the injury before the World Championships.
He said that although Bailey had taken part in Friday's meeting in Oslo his injury had worsened.
